metric_protocol.decode: Pillow convert RGB; uint8; no resize or alignment for metrics
metric_protocol.psnr: 10*log10(255^2/MSE), MSE over all RGB pixel channels; exact equality represented as string Infinity
metric_protocol.threshold_status: Maintainer-approved Qwen-Image-2.1 thresholds remain unconfirmed. Report per-case metrics and human requested-text/subject/edit checks; any LPIPS<=0.15 screen is provisional, not model acceptance.
metric_protocol.manual_review: Separate human exact-text/subject/edit fidelity review; retain BF16 errors and all failed or missing cases

qualitative_gate_protocol.status: fixed operational checks, not an A0-agreed numeric quality certification
qualitative_gate_protocol.fixed_text: no newly missing, incorrect, or unreadable requested text versus same-run BF16; distinguish pre-existing BF16 errors and ambiguous reading order
qualitative_gate_protocol.subject_and_edit: Preserve each case's specified subject and unchanged regions; complete the requested edit. Review every paired image and record pre-existing BF16 failures separately.
qualitative_gate_protocol.failures_and_black: retain all failed/missing outputs and detect exact all-zero decoded RGB images; near-black cases require visual review; decoded uint8 PNG cannot test upstream float NaN/Inf

cache_measurement: Record actual K/V shapes, prefix token lengths, per-layer stored dtype, scale dtype/shapes and summed storage bytes. Two references are a workload choice; do not infer actual cache length without recording it.
comparison: Compare storage candidates against the same-run auto result within each case, not absolute latency across different workloads.
upstream_cfg4_crosscheck: Optional separate #8099-matched teapot seed42,1024^2,50steps,true_cfg_scale=4.0,eager. Do not pool its scores with the CFG1 nine-case table.
